lines.text: Where did you get this. Don't shrug at me — the lump in your pack. It's ringing.
Put it on the anvil and it hums back at the hammer, a note early, like it knows what I'm about to do. Iron never once asked my opinion. This stuff is having a conversation.
I can try. Bring me every piece you find. If a blade comes out of this, it won't be my father's kind of blade — and I need to know whose kind it is.
